docs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
docs.text: Find quick answers to the most common questions about ArteryX.

docs.title: Can I trade paid ranks for in-game money?
docs.text:
Yes.

Players may trade paid ranks with other players using in-game money, as long as:

  • Both players agree to the trade.
  • The price is agreed upon by both players.
  • No real-money payment is involved.

Note

ArteryX staff are not responsible for player-to-player trades. Trade carefully.

docs.title: How do I earn money?
docs.text:
There are many ways to earn money on ArteryX:

  • OneBlock progression
  • Farming
  • Mining
  • Mob farming
  • Selling items
  • Player Shops
  • Auction House
  • Voting
  • Events
  • Custom server features

docs.title: How does OneBlock work?
docs.text:
Every player gets their own OneBlock island.

Break your OneBlock to progress through different phases and unlock new resources, blocks, and content.

Use:

/ob

to open the main OneBlock menu.

Useful commands include:

/ob upgrade
/ob phases
/ob settings
/ob warp
/ob level

docs.title: Can I upgrade my island?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob upgrade

to upgrade your island size.

Your island starts at:

50 × 50

and can eventually be upgraded up to:

250 × 250

docs.title: Can I change my OneBlock phase?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob phases

You can switch between phases that you have already unlocked.

docs.title: Are there Nether and End islands?
docs.text:
Yes.

ArteryX includes Nether and End OneBlock islands.

Both use the same island size system as your main island and are generated as void-style islands.

docs.title: Can I change my island settings?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob settings

to view and configure the available island settings.

docs.title: Can I teleport to my island?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob warp

to access your available island warps.

docs.title: Can I check my island level?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob level

to view your island level and progression.

docs.title: Is Keep Inventory enabled?
docs.text:
No.

Keep Inventory is disabled on ArteryX.

Death can cause you to lose the items you were carrying, so keep valuable items stored safely.

docs.title: Can I PvP?
docs.text:
Yes.

PvP is allowed where enabled.

Keep Inventory is disabled, so PvP deaths can result in item loss.

docs.title: Is teleport killing allowed?
docs.text:
Yes.

Teleport killing is allowed on ArteryX.

If you accept a teleport request or teleport somewhere dangerous, you are responsible for the outcome.

docs.title: Is trapping allowed?
docs.text:
Yes.

Player trapping is allowed using normal gameplay mechanics.

However, exploits, cheats, or server-crashing methods are not allowed.

docs.title: Can I AFK?
docs.text:
Yes.

AFKing is allowed.

However, using auto-clickers, bots, macros, or other automation to perform gameplay actions is not allowed.

docs.title: Can I use mods?
docs.text:
Yes.

Client-side mods are allowed as long as they do not provide an unfair gameplay advantage or automate gameplay.

Generally allowed:

  • Sodium
  • Iris
  • OptiFine
  • Shaders
  • Replay Mod
  • Performance mods
  • Cosmetic mods
  • Client-side UI mods
  • Minimap mods without unfair features

Not allowed:

  • X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Fly Hacks
  • Speed Hacks
  • Auto Mine
  • Auto Clickers
  • Combat automation
  • Gameplay automation
  • Any modification that provides an unfair advantage

If you are unsure about a mod, ask staff before using it.

docs.title: How do I get Crate Keys?
docs.text:
Crate Keys can be obtained through:

  • Voting
  • VoteParty
  • Events
  • Giveaways
  • Special rewards

docs.title: What happens if I get banned?
docs.text:
If you believe your punishment was incorrect, contact staff through Discord and open a support ticket.

Do not attempt to evade your punishment using another account.

docs.title: I found a bug. What should I do?
docs.text:
Report it privately to staff through Discord.

Do not abuse or share serious exploits.

docs.text:

docs.title: Server Rules
docs.text:
Play fair, respect others, and help keep ArteryX enjoyable for everyone.

Important

By joining ArteryX, you agree to follow these rules. Staff may take action against behavior that negatively affects the server, even if it is not specifically listed below.

docs.title: Respect Everyone
docs.text:
• Treat players and staff with respect.
  • Harassment, bullying, threats, and personal attacks are not allowed.
  • Hate speech and discrimination are prohibited.
  • Do not impersonate staff or other players.
  • Follow reasonable staff instructions.

docs.title: Fair Gameplay
docs.text:
Do not use cheats, exploits, or modifications that provide an unfair advantage.

Prohibited examples include:

  • X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Fly Hacks
  • Speed Hacks
  • Combat Hacks
  • Auto Mine
  • Auto Clickers
  • Gameplay automation
  • Macros that automate gameplay
  • Duplication glitches
  • Exploiting server bugs

If you discover an exploit, report it instead of abusing it.

docs.title: Island Protection
docs.text:
Each player has their own OneBlock island.

Do not intentionally destroy or interfere with another player's island without permission.

Be careful when giving other players access to your island.

docs.title: Trapping
docs.text:
Trapping is allowed.

Players may create traps using normal gameplay mechanics.

However, you may not use:

  • Bugs
  • Exploits
  • Cheats
  • Server-crashing methods

docs.title: Teleport Killing
docs.text:
Teleport killing is allowed.

If you accept a teleport request or teleport somewhere dangerous, you are responsible for the outcome.

Do not exploit teleport mechanics to bypass server protections.

docs.title: PvP Rules
docs.text:
PvP is allowed where enabled.

Because Keep Inventory is disabled, dying in PvP may result in losing your items.

Do not use cheats, exploits, or unfair modifications during PvP.

docs.title: Griefing & Theft
docs.text:
Do not intentionally destroy or steal from protected player areas.

Respect:

  • Player islands
  • Community builds
  • Spawn
  • Server infrastructure
  • Protected areas

Normal PvP, trapping, and competition are allowed where permitted by the server.

docs.title: Alternate Accounts
docs.text:
Alternate accounts must not be used to gain unfair advantages.

Do not use alternate accounts to:

  • Evade punishments
  • Abuse rewards
  • Manipulate leaderboards
  • Exploit voting systems
  • Bypass server restrictions

docs.title: Keep Chat Respectful
docs.text:
• Be respectful.
  • Do not harass or bully players.
  • No hate speech or discrimination.
  • No threats.
  • No NSFW or sexually explicit content.
  • Do not intentionally disrupt chat.

docs.title: Swearing
docs.text:
Normal occasional swearing is allowed.

Excessive, targeted, or abusive language may result in punishment.

docs.title: Spam
docs.text:
Do not:

  • Flood chat.
  • Repeatedly send the same message.
  • Abuse CAPS.
  • Spam commands.
  • Intentionally disrupt conversations.

docs.title: Advertising
docs.text:
Do not advertise other Minecraft servers or communities without permission.

This includes:

  • Other Minecraft servers
  • Server IPs
  • Discord servers
  • Websites
  • Recruitment links

docs.title: Discord Rules
docs.text:
Minecraft rules also generally apply within the ArteryX Discord.

Additionally:

  • No ping spam.
  • No harassment.
  • No inappropriate profile content.
  • Do not abuse support tickets.
  • Use the correct channels.
  • Follow staff instructions.

docs.title: Economy Rules
docs.text:
Keep the economy fair.

The following are prohibited:

  • Duplication glitches
  • Economy exploits
  • Reward abuse
  • Chargeback fraud
  • Shop exploits
  • Automated economy abuse
  • Manipulating server systems for unfair profit

Player-to-player trading is allowed.

Always verify trades before completing them.

docs.title: AFK & Automation
docs.text:
AFKing is allowed.

However, automation that performs gameplay actions for you is not allowed.

docs.title: Not allowed:
docs.text:
• Auto Clickers
  • AFK Bots
  • Gameplay Macros
  • Automated Mining
  • Automated Combat
  • Scripts that perform gameplay actions

Simply being AFK is allowed.

docs.title: Client-Side Mods
docs.text: Client-side mods are allowed as long as they do not provide an unfair gameplay advantage or automate gameplay.

docs.title: Generally Allowed
docs.text:
• Sodium
  • Iris
  • OptiFine
  • Performance Mods
  • Shaders
  • Replay Mod
  • Cosmetic Mods
  • Client-side UI Mods
  • Minimap Mods without unfair features

docs.title: Not Allowed
docs.text:
• X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Fly
  • Speed
  • Auto Clickers
  • Auto Mine
  • Combat Automation
  • Gameplay Automation
  • Any modification that provides an unfair advantage

If you are unsure about a modification, ask staff before using it.

docs.title: Exploits & Bugs
docs.text:
Do not intentionally abuse bugs or exploits.

This includes:

  • Duplication glitches
  • Economy exploits
  • Permission bypasses
  • Protection bypasses
  • Item duplication
  • Server-crashing exploits
  • Unintended mechanics used for unfair advantages

Report serious bugs privately to staff.

docs.title: Server Attacks
docs.text:
The following are strictly prohibited:

  • Intentionally crashing the server.
  • Attempting to overload the server.
  • DDoS attacks.
  • Intentionally creating extreme server lag.
  • Exploiting network vulnerabilities.
  • Sharing methods intended to damage the server.

docs.title: Staff Rules
docs.text:
Respect staff members.

If you believe a punishment was incorrect:

  1. Stay respectful.
  2. Open a Discord support ticket.
  3. Explain what happened.
  4. Provide evidence if available.

Do not start public arguments with staff.

docs.title: Punishment Guidelines
docs.text:
Offense Typical Punishment Chat Spam Warning → Mute Excessive Toxicity Warning → Mute Harassment Mute / Temporary Ban Advertising Temporary Ban X-Ray / Hacks Permanent Ban Auto Clicker Temporary Ban → Permanent Ban Duplication Exploits Temporary / Permanent Ban Serious Exploit Abuse Temporary / Permanent Ban Ban Evasion Permanent Ban Chargebacks Permanent Ban Staff Impersonation Temporary Ban Server Attacks Permanent Ban Inappropriate Builds Removal + Punishment

Note

Punishments are guidelines and may be increased or reduced depending on severity, player history, evidence, and circumstances.

docs.title: Questions?
docs.text:
Not sure whether something is allowed?

Ask staff before doing it.

Contact Staff

docs.title: Custom Features
docs.text: ArteryX adds a collection of quality-of-life features that improve survival without changing the vanilla experience.

docs.title: 🌳 Fast Leaf Decay
docs.text: Leaves decay much faster after breaking a tree, making wood farming quicker.

docs.title: 🏗️ Concrete Cauldron
docs.text: Right-click Concrete Powder on a Water Cauldron to instantly create Concrete.

docs.title: 🌱 Mud Cauldron
docs.text: Right-click Dirt on a Water Cauldron to convert it into Mud.

docs.title: 🟧 Copper Cauldrons
docs.text:
Special cauldrons make working with Copper easier.

  • 🟢 Slime Cauldron → Ages Copper
  • 🍯 Honey Cauldron → Waxes Copper

docs.title: 🐉 Dragon Rewards
docs.text: Every Ender Dragon has a 25% chance to drop an Elytra.

docs.title: 🖼 Better Paintings
docs.text: Scroll through painting variants before placing them.

docs.title: 🖌 Invisible Item Frames
docs.text: Use a Brush on an Item Frame to toggle its visibility.

docs.title: 🤫 Silent Mobs
docs.text:
Rename any mob:

Silence Me

or

silence_me

to permanently silence it.

docs.title: 🧪 XP Bottling
docs.text:
Store your experience using Glass Bottles.

docs.title: 🪚 Wooden Stonecutter
docs.text: The Stonecutter also works as a Sawmill, allowing more efficient wooden recipes.

docs.title: 📖 Auto Unlock Recipes
docs.text: All crafting recipes are unlocked automatically when you join.

docs.title: 🐺 Transfer Pets
docs.text: Safely transfer ownership of tamed pets to another player.

docs.title: 🐣 Keep Baby Animals Small

Name a baby mob:

Keep Small

Rename it:

Grow

to let it become an adult.

docs.title: 🧱 Mini Blocks
docs.text: Wandering Traders sell decorative Mini Blocks for builders.

docs.title: 💛 Vanilla, But Better
docs.text: Every feature is designed to save time, reduce repetitive tasks, and improve survival while keeping the gameplay feeling close to vanilla Minecraft.

docs.title: Flux Hopper
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers are upgraded hoppers designed to automate your farms and reduce manual work.

They collect nearby drops, transfer items faster than vanilla hoppers, and can send items directly into linked containers.

docs.title: 🔨 Crafting
docs.text:
Craft a Flux Hopper using the recipe below.

📷 Crafting Recipe

docs.title: 📈 Upgrade System
docs.text:
Each Flux Hopper can be upgraded.

Upgradeable stats include:

  • 📦 Transfer Amount
  • 🧲 Suction Radius
  • 🔗 Link Amount
  • 📍 Link Distance

Open the hopper menu after placing it to upgrade these stats.

docs.title: 🔗 Linking Containers
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers can connect directly to nearby storage.

Simply:

  1. Place your Flux Hopper.
  2. Open its menu.
  3. Click Links.
  4. Link nearby chests, barrels, or other containers.

This allows farms to stay fully automated without overflowing.

docs.title: 💰 Farm Automation
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers work perfectly with:

  • 🌾 Crop Farms
  • 🐄 Animal Farms
  • 👾 Forge Spawners
  • 🌳 Tree Farms

Pair them with Sell Wands for a complete automatic farming setup.

docs.title: ⭐ Why Use Flux Hoppers?
docs.text:
Compared to vanilla hoppers, Flux Hoppers offer:

  • Faster item transfer
  • Larger pickup radius
  • Container linking
  • Upgradeable performance
  • Better server performance
  • Cleaner automated farms

docs.title: 💡 Tips
docs.text:
• Upgrade the suction radius first for better collection.
  • Link multiple storage containers before increasing transfer speed.
  • Keep your hopper inside your claim to prevent griefing.

Money Making

Flux Hoppers become incredibly powerful when combined with Forge Spawners and Sell Wands, creating one of the best passive money methods on ArteryX.

docs.title: Making Money
docs.text: Whether you're just starting or building a massive empire, there are plenty of ways to earn money on ArteryX.

docs.title: 🌾 Farming
docs.text:
Build crop farms and sell your harvest using:

  • /shop
  • Sell Wands

The larger your farm, the more money you'll earn.

docs.title: ⛏️ Mining
docs.text:
Explore caves and gather valuable ores.

Sell your resources at:

/shop

or keep them for crafting and progression.

docs.title: 🐄 Mob Farms
docs.text:
Mob farms are one of the best long-term money makers.

Upgrade your farm with:

  • Forge Spawners
  • Flux Hoppers
  • Sell Wands

These three features work together to create a nearly automatic income.

docs.title: ⚡ Flux Hoppers
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers automatically collect nearby drops and move them into linked containers.

Perfect for:

  • Mob Farms
  • Crop Farms
  • Automatic Collection

Less manual work means more profit.

docs.title: 🪄 Sell Wands
docs.text:
Sell Wands instantly sell everything inside a chest.

Simply:

  1. Hold a Sell Wand.
  2. Right-click a container.
  3. Everything is sold instantly.

No moving items. No opening the shop. Just instant money.

docs.title: 🏪 Player Shops
docs.text:
Think your items are worth more than /shop?

Create your own player shop and sell directly to other players.

Popular resources often sell for much higher prices.

docs.title: ⚖️ Auction House
docs.text:
Sell rare or valuable items using:

/ah

The Auction House lets players bid or purchase items from one another.

Perfect for:

  • Rare Gear
  • Enchanted Items
  • Resources
  • Collectibles

docs.title: 📈 Shop Prices
docs.text:
The Server Shop is not completely static.

Some item prices may be:

  • 📈 Buffed
  • 📉 Nerfed

over time to help balance the economy and encourage players to explore different ways of making money.

docs.title: 💡 Best Money Setup
docs.text:
For the highest income, combine:

  • Forge Spawners
  • Flux Hoppers
  • Sell Wands

This creates a fast, efficient, and mostly automatic farming system.

Tip

Don't rely on just one income source. Farming, mining, player shops, and automatic farms together are the fastest way to become wealthy on ArteryX.

docs.title: 🏝️ OneBlock Islands
docs.text: Your island is the heart of your ArteryX journey. Build, expand, progress through OneBlock phases, create farms, and turn your island into an empire.

docs.title: 🧱 Creating Your Island
docs.text:
Create your island with:

/ob create

Every player starts with a 50 × 50 island.

Your island is your personal protected space where you can build, farm, automate, and progress without worrying about other players destroying your work.

docs.title: 📏 Island Upgrades
docs.text:
Need more room?

Use:

/ob upgrade

Your island starts at:

50 × 50

and can be upgraded all the way to:

250 × 250

Upgrading your island gives you more room for massive builds, farms, storage systems, mob farms, and automation.

Your upgraded island size also applies to your Nether and End islands.

docs.title: 🧱 OneBlock Phases
docs.text:
Your OneBlock changes as you progress through different phases.

View your unlocked phases with:

/ob phases

You can switch between any phases you have already unlocked, allowing you to return to previous phases whenever you need specific resources.

Progress through phases to unlock new blocks, ores, mobs, resources, and other content.

docs.title: ⚙️ Island Settings
docs.text:
Customize how your island works with:

/ob settings

Depending on your permissions and available settings, you can manage different island flags and gameplay options.

This is where you can control various interactions and island-related settings.

docs.title: 👥 Island Members
docs.text:
Playing alone isn't as fun.

Invite upto max 4 friends and build together on your island. Your island members can help with building, farms, automation, and progression.

Only invite players you trust.

docs.title: 🌀 Island Warp
docs.text:
Want players to visit your island?

Use:

/ob warp

Your island warp allows other players to visit your island without needing to manually navigate to it.

Perfect for showcasing your builds, shops, farms, or island projects.

docs.title: 📊 Island Level
docs.text:
Want to see how developed your island is?

Use:

/ob level

Your island level represents the value and progression of your island.

Build with valuable blocks, expand your island, and create impressive structures to increase your island level.

docs.title: 🔥 Nether Island
docs.text:
ArteryX also features a dedicated Nether island.

The Nether island is a void environment connected to your main island progression, giving you a dedicated space for Nether builds, farms, and resources.

Your Nether island uses the same size as your main island.

For example:

Overworld → 100 × 100
Nether    → 100 × 100

docs.title: 🐉 End Island
docs.text:
The End also has its own dedicated void island.

Use it for End progression, farms, builds, and late-game projects.

Just like the Nether, its size matches your main island:

Overworld → 150 × 150
Nether    → 150 × 150
End       → 150 × 150

Upgrade your island to increase the available space across your dimensions.

docs.title: 🛡️ Island Protection
docs.text:
Your island is protected from unauthorized players.

Other players cannot freely:

  • ❌ Break your blocks
  • ❌ Place blocks
  • ❌ Destroy your builds
  • ❌ Steal from your island
  • ❌ Interfere with your farms

You control who can access and interact with your island.

docs.title: 🎒 Keep Inventory
docs.text:
Keep Inventory is disabled on ArteryX.

Dying can cause you to lose the items you're carrying, so store valuable resources safely before taking unnecessary risks.

docs.title: 🚀 Your OneBlock Journey
docs.text:
🧱 Create your island
       ↓
⛏️ Break your OneBlock
       ↓

Useful Commands

`/ob` — View available OneBlock commands  
`/ob create` — Create your island  
`/ob settings` — Manage island settings and flags  
`/ob phases` — View and switch between unlocked phases  
`/ob upgrade` — Upgrade your island size  
`/ob warp` — Manage your island warp  
`/ob level` — View your island level

Island Size

Islands start at 50 × 50 and can be upgraded up to **250 × 250**. Your Nether and End islands follow the same size.

Death

Keep Inventory is disabled. Store valuable items before heading into dangerous areas.

docs.title: Seasons
docs.text:
ArteryX features a fully dynamic Season System that changes the world throughout the year.

Each season brings unique weather, lighting, particles, decorations, mob behavior, and exclusive rewards—making survival feel fresh every time you play.

docs.title: 🌎 Seasonal Cycle
docs.text:
The world automatically rotates through four unique seasons.

🌸 Spring

Life returns as nature awakens across the world.

  • Flowers bloom across the landscape
  • Fireflies appear after sunset
  • Bees and passive animals spawn more frequently
  • Pleasant weather
☀️ Summer

Bright days, warm nights, and clear skies.

  • Longest daytime of the year
  • Higher chance of clear weather
  • Shooting stars appear at night
  • Husks replace Zombies
🍂 Autumn

The world transforms with vibrant autumn colours.

  • Falling leaves
  • Leaf litter beneath trees
  • More Foxes and Bats
  • Pumpkin-wearing mobs
❄️ Winter

Snow blankets the world as temperatures drop.

  • Snowfall across the world
  • Cold breath particles
  • Short days and long nights
  • Strays replace Skeletons

docs.title: 🕒 Day & Night Length
docs.text:
Unlike vanilla Minecraft, every season has different daylight hours.

Season Day Night 🌸 Spring Medium Medium ☀️ Summer Long Short 🍂 Autumn Medium Medium ❄️ Winter Short Long

docs.title: ✨ Seasonal Effects
docs.text:
Throughout the year you'll notice:

  • 🍃 Falling Leaves
  • ✨ Fireflies
  • ☄️ Shooting Stars
  • ❄️ Cold Breath
  • 🌳 Seasonal Tree Colors
  • 🍂 Leaf Litter
  • 🌦 Dynamic Weather
  • 🌎 Seasonal Ambience

docs.title: 👾 Seasonal Mobs
docs.text:
Some creatures become more common depending on the current season.

Season Changes 🌸 Spring More Bees & passive mobs ☀️ Summer Husks replace Zombies 🍂 Autumn More Foxes & Bats, Pumpkin mobs ❄️ Winter Strays replace Skeletons

docs.title: 🎁 Seasonal Crates
docs.text:
Every season introduces its own exclusive crate.

At the beginning of each new season, every player receives:

🎁 1 Seasonal Crate Key

Current seasonal crates include:

  • 🌸 Spring Crate
  • ☀️ Summer Crate
  • 🍂 Autumn Crate
  • ❄️ Winter Crate

Each crate contains exclusive seasonal rewards that are only available during that season.

Open them anytime at:

/warp crates

docs.title: 🎉 Seasonal Events
docs.text: Special events automatically activate during holidays.

docs.title: 🎃 Halloween
docs.text:
• Stronger hostile mobs
  • Pumpkin enemies
  • Flaming Skeletons
  • Special Halloween atmosphere

docs.title: 🎄 Christmas
docs.text:
• Christmas decorations
  • Presents around villages
  • Holiday announcements
  • Exclusive festive rewards

docs.title: 🎆 New Year
docs.text:
• Firework celebrations
  • Village festivities
  • Limited-time surprises

docs.title: 🚀 More Coming Soon
docs.text:
The Seasons system will continue to expand with future updates.

Planned additions include:

  • 🎁 New Seasonal Rewards
  • 🧩 Seasonal Quests
  • 👒 Exclusive Cosmetics
  • 🏆 Community Events
  • 🎊 Limited-Time Activities

Every season is designed to make ArteryX feel like a brand new world.

docs.title: Sell Wands
docs.text:
Sell Wands instantly sell everything inside a chest with a single click.

They're one of the biggest quality-of-life features on ArteryX.

docs.title: How to Use
docs.text:
1. Hold a Sell Wand.
  2. Right-click a container.
  3. Everything inside is sold instantly.

No need to manually sell items anymore.

docs.title: Tiers
docs.text: There are 3 Sell Wand tiers.

docs.title: 🪵 Stick Sell Wand
docs.text:
Perfect for beginners.

Uses:

  • 5
  • 25
  • 50

docs.title: 🌬️ Breeze Sell Wand
docs.text:
Great for growing farms.

Uses:

  • 75
  • 150
  • 250

docs.title: 🔥 Blaze Sell Wand
docs.text:
Built for large automatic farms.

Uses:

  • 500
  • 750
  • 1000

docs.title: Crafting
docs.text:
Players can craft a beginner Sell Wand with:

✅ 5 Uses

docs.title: Crates
docs.text:
Higher tier Sell Wands can be obtained from:

  • Common Crates
  • Rare Crates
  • Epic Crates
  • Legendary Crates

docs.title: Selling Prices
docs.text:
Sell Wands use the exact same prices as:

/shop

They simply save time by selling everything instantly.

Tip

Pair Sell Wands with Flux Hoppers and Forge Spawners to create one of the most efficient money-making setups on the server.

docs.title: Forge Spawners
docs.text:
Forge Spawners are one of the fastest ways to build fully automated farms and generate a steady income.

Unlike vanilla, every player can eventually obtain and move spawners.

docs.title: 🛒 Getting a Spawner
docs.text: There are two ways to obtain a spawner.

docs.title: ⛏ Mine One
docs.text: Spawners can be mined using a Silk Touch Pickaxe.

docs.title: 💰 Buy One
docs.text:
Purchase any spawner directly using:

/spawner get

Price:

$75,000

docs.title: ⚡ Upgrading Your Farm
docs.text:
Spawners become even more powerful when combined with:

  • ⚙ Flux Hoppers
  • 💸 Sell Wands
  • 📦 Large Storage Systems

This allows you to create completely automated money farms.

docs.title: 📦 Supported Mobs
docs.text:
Most vanilla mob spawners are supported.

Common choices include:

  • Zombie
  • Skeleton
  • Spider
  • Blaze
  • Breeze
  • Cave Spider
  • Pig
  • Cow
  • Chicken
  • Sheep

More mob types may become available through future updates.

docs.title: 💡 Tips
docs.text:
• Place your spawners inside a claimed area.
  • Use Flux Hoppers to automatically collect drops.
  • Use Sell Wands to instantly sell your farm's loot.
  • Upgrade your farm over time for maximum profit.

Best Combo

Forge Spawner + Flux Hopper + Sell Wand = One of the easiest ways to earn money on ArteryX.
